correctness.rationale: The star center Schur complement is P=I-J/n. Under the specified ordered SampleClique law each i<n independently chooses a uniform later parent and creates a tree edge of conductance (n-i)/n. Each possible edge has expected conductance 1/n, proving E[T]=P. Backward induction on pendant arrivals yields E[R_T(i,j)]=n/(n-i)+(n-i-1)n/(n-i)=n for all distinct vertices and every n>=2. Double-centering E[R] yields E[T^dagger]=(n/2)P, and deterministic last edge (n-1,n) of resistance n gives Rayleigh quotient n/2 and lambda_min(T|1perp)<=2/n. Independently replayed exact fraction enumeration over all (n-1)! parent maps for n=2..7; no finite cutoff is used as the infinite proof. Nullspace centered on 1 and reciprocal weight conventions are explicit.
